classification.difficultyReason: Foundation: all four statements require direct reading of the taught stem-and-leaf representation to identify the youngest and oldest ages and check whether ages 17 and 20 occur. No connection beyond combining the stem and leaf is required.

content.prompt: This stem-and-leaf plot shows ages of people in a group. Answer true or false:

spec.description: Stem-and-leaf plot beside the statements, without a key.
spec.answerVisibility: All plot entries are permanent givens; true/false answers are excluded.

answer.worked: The smallest entry is $0\mid8$, representing 8 years.
Stem 2 has leaves 1 and 4, but no leaf 0, so nobody listed is 20.
The largest entry is $2\mid4$, representing 24 years.
